title: SIDESTORY: PATH OF LIFE OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: PATH OF LIFE OPEN
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 24, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Path of Life event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- Phase 1 "Deploy Beacons"
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2 "Fortify Defense"
DURATION: December 10, 2024, 16:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Conundra of the Sophontheatrum]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Conundra of the Sophontheatrum] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Underflow], Abyssal Hunter Lab (Pieces), Module Materials, 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chip, etc.
[Materianomicon Moderatrix]
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 24, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chips by clearing event stages and completing [Conundra of the Sophontheatrum] missions. 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chips can be used to redeem items from [Materianomicon Moderatrix].

REWARDS: Underflow's token, Abyssal Hunter Lab (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, EPOQUE Collection Series - Invisible Dirge for Manticore, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
*During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ANCHOR IN THE DEEP
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Anchor In The Deep], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Ulpianus
★★★★★: Lucilla / Grain Buds

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Ulpianus
★★★★★: Lucilla / Underflow
Note:
Operator Underflow is currently ONLY available from the Path of Life event, and is NOT available in [Anchor In The Deep] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
Ulpianus and Lucilla will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after December 17, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
Ulpianus, Lucilla, and Underflow will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 STARTER HEADHUNTING UPDATED
DETAILS: For Doctors who create their account after the update on December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7), the operators available in the [Starter Headhunting] will be:
★★★★★★: SilverAsh / Exusiai / Mountain / Thorns / Saria / Blaze
★★★★★: Platinum / Ptilopsis / La Pluma / Silence / Projekt Red / Warfarin / Elysium / Blue Poison / Lappland / Liskarm / Nearl / Manticore / Shamare / Astesia / Whisperain / Specter
05 ADDITIONAL REWARDS FOR NEWBIE DOCTORS

DETAILS: After the event begins, a mail containing the following rewards will be sent to Doctors who register and create an account before December 3, 10:00 (UTC-7): Top Operator Transfer Permit - Starter *1 (choose from one of the following 6-star Operators: [SilverAsh], [Exusiai], [Mountain], [Thorns], [Saria], [Blaze]), Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit *1, Headhunting Permit *1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter *1, Senior Operator Training Apparatus *1, Advanced Material Voucher *8 (Doctors who register after December 3, 10:00 (UTC-7) can obtain these rewards from [Get familiar with Rhodes Island])
Mail will be sent on: December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Available for claim: Within 180 days from the first login after December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Mail will be sent to: All Doctors who register and create an account before December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
06 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - I Am the Tides for Gladiia
EPOQUE Collection - Scribing for Penance
EPOQUE Collection - For the Banquet for Melanite
07 0011 TEMPEST SERIES & TEST COLLECTION SERIES RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
0011 Tempest Series - Hear the Wind Sing for Fartooth
0011 Tempest Series - The Fruition for Shalem
0011 Tempest Series - The Road to Here for Paprika
Test Collection Series - There They Be for Saga
08 NEW FURNITURE SET – ABYSSAL HUNTER LAB
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Abyssal Hunter Lab will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Path of Life event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
09 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
[GUARD CHIP PACK]
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
[Heavy Funding Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 21, LMD * 1000000
[Starter Monthly Pack]
CONTENTS: Monthly Card Exchange Permit *1 (Effective immediately upon purchase and not restricted by Monthly Card time limits), Headhunting Permit *3

NOTE: This newly available [Starter Monthly Pack] will replace the current [Starter Advanced Pack] at the store. Doctors who have already purchased the [Starter Advanced Pack] can purchase the [Starter Monthly Pack] again.
[Starter Special Training Pack]
CONTENTS: Advanced Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter *1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter *1, Professional Operator Training Invitation Letter *2

Professional Operator Training Invitation Letter: Use to level up a 4-star operator who has not yet been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 1. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
10 NEW REDEEMABLES AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
UPDATE TIME: December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New redeemables in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
Operator Scene and Token
Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Legacy for Siege
11 0011 YUN SERIES NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 17, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
0011 Yun Series - Fragrant Pace for Grain Buds
12 FESTIVAL SIGN-IN EVENT
DURATION: December 3, 2024, 10:00 – December 13, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Elite Materials, and more. Participants in the Support Event during the first 5 days can win furniture depending on the flavor they choose to support.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 4: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 5: Skill Summary - 1 * 30, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 6: Furniture Part * 300, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
NOTE:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.

- In this event, the furniture that players can obtain will be determined by the flavor they choose to support (Sweetsalt Liberal Doctors will get the reward of the winning side). That is to say, only one type of furniture between the two can be obtained from this event.
13 SPECIAL SEASONAL VOICE LINES UPCOMING
UPDATE TIME: December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After December 3, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7), new special seasonal voice lines will be available. Players can check them out to receive words of blessings from operators in certain times of the year.
OTHERS:
Lingering Echoes available in [Side Story]
Starts at: December 17, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
FURNITURE: Afterglow-Styled Music Room (Pieces)
DURATION: Available from December 17, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Achievement Star Collection & Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics Re-edition
DURATION: December 17, 2024, 10:00 – December 31, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Achievement Star Collection - Sport For All - Flametail
- Achievement Star Collection - Light Gun Adjuster - Aosta
- Achievement Star Collection - Trendsetting Player - Kirara
- Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Freeland Tuneseeker for Czerny
Please stay tuned for more information!
